responsibility: This machine-description helper file declares the textual RTL predicates and special predicates used across NDS32 instruction patterns. It names comparison classes, symbolic and immediate operand categories, move/logical operand legality, register and floating-register classes, memory-base forms, and wrappers around C-side validators for multiple load/store and stack operations, making it the md-visible predicate layer that complements nds32-predicates.cc.
